description: Ravion is the agent-native cloud infrastructure platform to deploy, operate and monitor your AWS services. Use your existing Terraform or provision from our standard library.
rules: Declare projects, environments, and module instances in a project config file (ravion.yaml, .jsonc, or .cue) kept in source control.
Apply config with `ravion project config apply <project-id> --file ravion.yaml`, and use `--dry-run` first to review planned changes.
Prefer standard library modules (types prefixed `rvn-`) over hand-written Terraform, and wire modules together with `moduleGivenIdRef`.
Reference secrets from AWS Secrets Manager with `valueFrom` instead of putting plaintext values in the config.
